item.title: Unfinished repair. Street gutter needs permanent cover, 24th September
item.description:
Street gutter running through public footpath needs replacing. During a previous repair Gloucester highways removed a section of the cover and filled in the conduit with tarmac. After complaints that this meant water backflowed into the basement of No.8 Russell street they removed the tarmac and replaced it with a temporary cover however did not come back and complete the job. Needs a new permanent cover that allows rain water to pass underneath to the drain on the street.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 4, Russell Street, Wymans Brook, Cheltenham, Cheltenham
